common.name: Full name
common.offline: You’re offline. Changes will need a connection.

landing.h1a: Guidance from people who sat in
landing.sub: Verified alumni of {{college}} mentor you, refer you, and show you the exact path from where you are to where they got.
landing.foot: Private to {{college}}. Only verified students, alumni and faculty can see anything here.

auth.mfaSub: Open your authenticator app for CampusLink.
auth.resent: If that email has an account, a new link is on its way.
auth.signUpSub: Takes a minute. College verification comes next.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few unusual words work well.

consent.account: Run my account: sign-in, security and showing my profile to verified members of my college. Required.
consent.mentorship_matching: Use my branch, interests and goals to suggest mentors and mentees.
consent.email_digests: Send me a weekly email with openings and guidance from my college.
consent.analytics_aggregate: Count my activity in anonymous, college-level statistics.

auth.privacyNote: You can change these any time in Settings → Privacy. We never sell or share your data.
auth.checkEmailBody: If the details are right, a confirmation link is on its way to {{email}}. It works for 24 hours.
auth.forgotSub: We’ll email you a link that works for 30 minutes.
auth.forgotSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.
auth.resetDone: Password saved. You’ve been signed out everywhere else.
auth.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open it again from your email.

mfa.setupWhy: Administrators must use 2FA. It keeps your college’s data safe even if a password leaks.
mfa.step1: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or 2FAS).
mfa.manual: Can’t scan? Enter this key manually:
mfa.codesBody: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe. We won’t show them again.

home.unverifiedTitle: Your account is read-only for now
home.unverifiedBody: Your college still needs to confirm you’re a student or alumnus. Roll-number verification arrives next; until then you can browse but not post or request mentoring.
home.secureBody: Sessions, 2FA and privacy choices are in Settings.

phase.mentorship: Mentor requests, booking, chat and video
phase.feed: Your college feed, tips and “One useful thing”

settings.title: Settings
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
settings.consentsBody: Each choice is recorded with the date and the version of the notice you saw. Turning one off takes effect immediately.
settings.rights: Download or delete your data: self-service export and deletion arrive with the privacy release. Until then, contact your college’s grievance officer.

admin.brandingIntro: These colours and names appear on every screen and email for your college. Text colours are adjusted automatically to stay readable.
admin.featuresIntro: Turn features on or off for your whole college.
admin.allowedDomainsHint: Comma-separated, e.g. dpit.ac.in. Leave empty to allow any email.

platform.title: Colleges
platform.created: College created. The administrator has been emailed an invite.
platform.suspendConfirm: Suspend {{name}}? Everyone there is signed out until you resume it.
platform.privacyNote: You see aggregate counts only. Messages and profiles belong to each college.

errors.noCollegeTitle: No college lives at this address
errors.noCollegeBody: Check the link your college shared. Each college has its own address, like yourcollege.campuslink.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have access to this page.
